article_title: Nicotine vapes best chance to quit smoking, major review finds

tasks.prompt: What is the main finding reported in the article?
options: Nicotine vapes give smokers a better chance of quitting than patches, gum or pills
Nicotine patches work better than every other quitting aid
All vaping products are completely harmless
People should replace approved vapes with illicit devices
tasks.correct_answer: Nicotine vapes give smokers a better chance of quitting than patches, gum or pills
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הממצא המרכזי הוא שסיגריות אלקטרוניות עם ניקוטין סייעו לגמילה מעישון יותר מאמצעים מסורתיים כגון מדבקות, מסטיק או גלולות.

tasks.prompt: Which comparison did the major review make?
options: Approved vapes versus exercise programmes
Nicotine vapes versus traditional stop-smoking aids
Cigarettes versus air pollution
Different flavours of illegal vapes
tasks.correct_answer: Nicotine vapes versus traditional stop-smoking aids
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסקירה השוותה סיגריות אלקטרוניות עם ניקוטין לאמצעי גמילה מסורתיים, ובהם תחליפי ניקוטין ותרופות.

tasks.prompt: What safety distinction does the article make?
options: Every vape is regulated in exactly the same way
Vaping is entirely risk-free for children
Regulated products differ from illicit or non-compliant devices
Unapproved devices are safer because they contain more chemicals
tasks.correct_answer: Regulated products differ from illicit or non-compliant devices
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מבדילה בין מוצרים מפוקחים העומדים בדרישות לבין מוצרים בלתי חוקיים או לא תקניים שעלולים להכיל חומרים מסוכנים.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article warn readers not to interpret “safer than smoking” as “safe”?
options: Because vaping can still expose users to nicotine and potentially harmful substances
Because cigarettes contain no harmful chemicals
Because regulated devices are designed only for children
Because every person who vapes immediately starts smoking
tasks.correct_answer: Because vaping can still expose users to nicotine and potentially harmful substances
tasks.explanation_hebrew: פחות מסוכן מעישון אינו פירושו נטול סיכון; אידוי עדיין עלול לחשוף לניקוטין ולחומרים מזיקים.

tasks.prompt: In the report, what does “outperformed” mean when nicotine vapes outperformed traditional aids?
options: Were more expensive to manufacture
Produced better quitting results
Were tested for a shorter time
Contained fewer instructions
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה outperformed פירושו השיג תוצאות טובות יותר בסיוע לאנשים להפסיק לעשן.

tasks.prompt: What does “regulated” mean in the article's discussion of vaping products?
options: Controlled under official rules and safety requirements
Sold without any legal checks
Made only in one colour
Used for an unlimited amount of time
tasks.correct_answer: Controlled under official rules and safety requirements
tasks.explanation_hebrew: regulated פירושו מפוקח לפי כללים ודרישות רשמיות, בניגוד למוצר בלתי חוקי או לא תקני.

tasks.prompt: Give two practical safety messages for a smoker who decides to use a vape to quit.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי המלצות בטיחות קונקרטיות מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Use a regulated or approved vaping device
Avoid illicit or non-compliant products
Buy from a reputable or legal source
Remember that vaping is not entirely risk-free
Use vaping as a route away from smoking rather than as a product for non-smokers

tasks.prompt: Why might adjustable nicotine levels help some smokers stop using nicotine gradually?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את רעיון הגמילה ההדרגתית ואת הקשר להפחתת ניקוטין.
expected_points: A user can reduce the nicotine strength over time
Gradual reduction can make the transition away from nicotine more manageable
The method can preserve part of the familiar habit while nicotine is reduced
The eventual aim is to stop smoking and, where possible, stop nicotine use

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article's evidence and its safety warning in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את ממצא הסקירה, השוואה לאמצעי גמילה אחרים, והסתייגות בטיחותית אחת לפחות.
expected_points: A major review found nicotine vapes more effective than patches, gum or pills for quitting smoking
Vaping is described as safer than smoking, not entirely safe
Regulated products are different from illicit or non-compliant devices
Illegal products may contain harmful substances or unsafe components
The article presents vaping as a quitting aid for smokers, not an invitation for non-smokers or children

tasks.prompt: Write brief advice to an adult smoker choosing between cigarettes, an approved vape and an illicit vape. Use evidence from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח עצה ברורה באנגלית ולהסתמך על לפחות שני פרטים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Quitting smoking is the main health goal
Nicotine vapes can offer a better quitting chance than some traditional aids
An approved or regulated device is preferable to an illicit product
Vaping is not entirely safe even though it is safer than smoking
Avoid products that may contain harmful chemicals or unstable components
Seek professional stop-smoking support where available
